name: focus-mode
description: Focus Mode — distraction lockdown dashboard: React dashboard + Express/MongoDB API + Focus Agent (Electron).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace agent
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "server,client,agent" --prefix-colors "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client" "npm run dev --workspace agent"
